info.title: easy-auth
info.description: Experimental same-origin browser API; not an OIDC issuer. POST requests require the exact configured Origin. HTTPS production cookies use __Host- prefix, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ and no Domain. Development loopback cookies omit the prefix and Secure. Auth responses are no-store.

204.description: Authentication account deleted; cookies cleared; audit subject removed

202.description: Deletion proof sent to current address; no account deleted yet

204.description: Verified contact attached; UUID/policy/authentication provenance preserved; rotated session

202.description: Generic contact proof request; fresh passkey session required; sets independent binding
One address confirmed; confirm the other proof

204.description: Both addresses confirmed; email changed; sessions/proofs revoked; login required

202.description: Proofs sent to both addresses; sets change binding cookie

204.description: Sets fresh HttpOnly session; clears binding cookie

202.description: Generic response; sets HttpOnly browser binding

204.description: Atomic verified credential update/session/audit; sets fresh session cookie

200.description: Persisted browser-bound options; sets/reuses HttpOnly binding cookie

201.description: Verified credential inserted once; no authenticated session issued

200.description: Fresh authenticated enrollment options; sets/reuses HttpOnly browser binding

204.description: Verified assertion; atomic account/key/session/audit creation; sets fresh session cookie

200.description: Verified candidate is pending; assertion still required; no session issued
Pending resident registration; no account/session yet; sets/reuses HttpOnly binding

204.description: Enrolled once; previous sessions revoked; sets replacement session cookie
Password replaced; all sessions and outstanding proofs invalidated; clears reset/session cookies; login required

202.description: Generic response; sets reset binding cookie; same delivery path for every email

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Continue after the previous page's public UUID cursor.

200.description: At most 50 owned active sessions; public metadata only; next is a UUID cursor

204.description: Owned session revoked; unknown/foreign/inactive IDs are the same no-op. Current-session revocation clears cookies
All owned sessions including caller revoked, pending proofs canceled, cookies cleared; new login required

userHandle.description: Base64url owner UUID. Mandatory for discovery; checked against the stored owner.

attestationObject.description: Base64url CBOR attestation object, checked by the high-level verifier.

authenticatorData.description: Optional browser convenience fields; identity comes only from verified attestation data.

clientDataJSON.description: Base64url exact client-data JSON bytes bound to the challenge, origin and signature.

userVerification.description: Always required. Client-provided changes cannot weaken server verification.
Required by this implementation. User presence alone is insufficient.

extensions.description: Standard WebAuthn extensions; never accepted as independently trusted identity claims.

alg.description: COSE algorithm identifier from the high-level verifier's secure algorithm list.

id.description: Base64url credential ID, used as an exclusion hint only.
Base64url-encoded opaque UUID bytes, not an email or caller-selected owner.

oneOf.description:
Opaque account hint from a remembered profile or trusted account selection.
This API does not resolve email addresses to credential lists.
Modal resident-credential selection; no account is selected before proof.
Opportunistic resident-credential autofill; frontend must support conditional UI.

discoverable.description: Explicitly request browser residence. Success is not independently verified residence metadata.

label.description: Human-readable label; 1–256 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank, no control characters.

display_name.description: Presentation only: 1–256 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank, no control characters.

password.description: NFC normalized; 15–256 Unicode code points, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

id.description: A public session ID, not a bearer secret.

authenticated_at_ms.description: Null for legacy sessions without trustworthy authentication-time provenance.

id.description: Canonical base64url ID matching both rawId and the verified attested credential ID.

mediation.description: Only conditional autofill supplies this hint. Omitted for modal/account-bound UI.
